one_thing: One private conversation with one person, through your own iCloud, hidden behind a cover the user chooses (gift list or notes in 1.0, or none). Each cover is a real tool with its own one figure; a secret code opens the conversation.

features.name: Cover chosen by the user
features.description: At first run and later in Info, the user picks how the app shows itself: a cover (the screen the app opens on) (alternate icons follow in a later version). 1.0 covers, each a real working tool built from SbuKit on surface, with its own one figure + SbuFullStop: Regali (gift list: people, ideas, price, occasion date, bought yes/no; the one figure is the total still to spend; unlock: a new gift whose price is the code, then Salva) and Note (a plain local notes list; a note titled with the code). No calculator: it is the best-known vault cover and the first thing a suspicious person tries. Plus 'Nessuna': opens on a plain code keypad (Face ID only as a second step after the code, never instead of it). The unlock gesture is described on the cover's setup screen and in the listing. Each cover is a pure type with Swift Testing tests. Covers never imitate Apple's apps: Sbu engraving icons, Sbu tokens. Every cover passes candidate input to one shared Unlock type (pure, tested): input that matches the code is never stored (the Notes cover discards a note whose title is the code before saving; laps and conversions that unlock are not kept in history). Inputs that do not match stay as normal tool data.
features.reason: The user decides how to hide it. A gift list has a ready excuse for being hidden ('it's for your surprises') and nobody digs into their own surprises; a calculator in the Hidden folder is suspicious by itself.

features.name: Secret code
features.description: Set at first run (6 to 10 digits, typed twice). Never stored, not even as a hash: there is no separate verifier. The code is checked only by unwrapping the private key (PBKDF2-SHA256 with CommonCrypto, iterations tuned to about 100 ms on device, then HKDF with the Secure Enclave secret, then the AES-GCM tag): a wrong code fails the tag. Only the salt and the wrapped key are in the Keychain (kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly), so a copy of the Keychain cannot be guessed offline without this device's Secure Enclave. Wrong code: the cover treats it as normal input (a gift price, a note), no error. Silent throttling: after 5 wrong candidate inputs from any cover, where a candidate is any input of 6 to 10 digits, the allowed range, never the real code's length, which is not stored anywhere (short everyday inputs never count), counted in one shared Keychain counter so switching cover does not reset it, the correct code is ignored for growing intervals (1, 5, 15, 60 min), persisted in the Keychain so a relaunch does not reset it; elapsed time is measured with the monotonic clock (mach_continuous_time, immune to changing the date), and a reboot (new kern.boottime) restarts the current interval from zero instead of ending it; the cover never shows a lockout. Forgotten code: there is no reset that keeps the conversation. 'Reimposta' (long-press on the cover's figure, then device authentication) erases the local store and the Keychain item and leaves the share (participant) or deletes the zone (owner), after a destructive confirm. Accepted trade-off: someone with the device passcode can destroy the conversation but never read it; the zone is deleted anyway because its sealed content is useless without the old key. Ending the conversation from inside it still needs the code. Documented in the listing. Fresh install that finds an existing zone or Keychain item and gets no valid code: it offers only 'Elimina e ricomincia' (deletes zone, share, Keychain item and Secure Enclave key); it never fetches content into view, and sealed records it cannot open are never kept.
features.reason: Calculator#: 17 reviews about a forgotten password. Here the person to hide from may know the device passcode, so recovery must not reveal anything: losing the code costs the conversation, never its privacy.

features.name: Back to the cover
features.description: Leaving the app, locking the phone or turning it face down (CMMotionManager gravity) closes the conversation and shows the chosen cover in its empty state. The app switcher snapshot shows the cover.
features.reason: The cover must hold when someone picks up the phone.

features.name: Hide with iOS
features.description: Last step of setup: one screen that explains, with the system's own words, how to hide the app (iOS 18+: hold the icon, 'Richiedi Face ID', 'Nascondi e richiedi Face ID'; iOS 17: remove from the home screen, it stays in the App Library). The app never tries to hide itself; the cover is the second layer for whoever opens the Hidden folder.
features.reason: Users will hide it no matter what; the OS feature also removes it from Spotlight and silences notifications. Duo does not need to imitate what iOS already does.

features.name: Pair with one person
features.description: The first launch creates one CloudKit record zone and a CKShare with readWrite permission for one participant, sent with the system share sheet (UICloudSharingController / ShareLink, Messages, AirDrop). The other person opens the link, accepts with their Apple ID, and the app opens on the conversation. One conversation per app, ever: no list of chats, no contacts lookup.
features.reason: Originale: 'It ONLY works with the one person that you're synced with'; there it needs an account and a sync code. Here the Apple ID replaces both (ADR-0011).

features.name: Messages
features.description: Text messages as CKRecords in the shared zone, text in encryptedValues. Append-only: each person writes only their own records, so nothing to merge. Local store in SwiftData, CloudKit changes fetched with CKFetchRecordZoneChangesOperation (owner: private database, participant: shared database). Sent, delivered (on the server) and failed states with a word and a symbol; failed messages retry with 'Riprova'. Local store and photo cache with NSFileProtectionComplete, excluded from device backups (isExcludedFromBackup); CloudKit is the only copy off the device. End-to-end encryption, independent of iCloud: at pairing each device creates a Curve25519 key pair (CryptoKit), publishes only the public key as a record in the zone and derives keys with KeyAgreement + HKDF<SHA256>, salt = the zone ID, and a distinct info label per use: one sending key per direction ('duo/v1/msg/<sender public key>'), one for photos, never the same key for two purposes. AES-GCM with a fresh random 96-bit nonce per message; the record ID and sender go into the authenticated data. The key that wraps the private key is a separate HKDF output ('duo/v1/wrap') over the PBKDF2 output and the Secure Enclave secret, never reused elsewhere. Every message text and photo is sealed with AES-GCM before it reaches CloudKit and stays sealed in the local store. The private key lives only in the Keychain, wrapped by a key that needs both the code (PBKDF2) and a non-exportable Secure Enclave P256 key (SecureEnclave.P256.KeyAgreement, ThisDeviceOnly, combined with HKDF): guessing the code is only possible on this device, through the throttle, never offline. Without the code nothing is readable: not the local store, not the zone, not after delete and reinstall (the Keychain item survives but stays wrapped). Fail closed: any Keychain, Secure Enclave or decryption error shows the cover as if the code were wrong; nothing is ever shown unsealed by a fallback. Key authentication: each device shows at pairing a 6-digit safety code computed from both public keys, the same on both phones; nothing can be sent or shown until both confirm it matches (in person or on a call). The verified key is pinned; if the partner's key ever changes, the app neither sends nor opens anything signed with the new key until the code is compared again ('La chiave è cambiata', warning symbol).
features.reason: The thing itself. Reviews of the originale: 'Consistently fails to send messages', 'Keep receiving messages but I can't see anything', 'decryption key error'. CloudKit encryption is managed by Apple: no key to lose.

features.name: Photos
features.description: Photos from PhotosPicker or the camera, stored as CKAsset, downscaled to 2048 px. Blurred in the thread until tapped (toggle in Settings, on by default). Save to Photos and delete always available, multi-select delete in the gallery.
features.reason: Originale: 'I love the blurred out images'; 'You can't save photos or videos without paying AND you can't delete them without paying'; 'wish we could delete multiple photos at once'.

features.name: Face ID after the code
features.description: Optional second step after the secret code, LocalAuthentication.
features.reason: Originale: 'The app is password protected', 'four children at home'.

features.name: Random neutral notifications
features.description: CKDatabaseSubscription (shouldSendContentAvailable) wakes the app; it fetches changes and posts a local notification whose text is picked at random from a neutral list that fits the chosen cover (Regali: 'Promemoria', 'Un compleanno si avvicina'; Note: 'Nota aggiornata', 'Promemoria'), editable in Info; never a name, never a preview, never mimicking iOS system alerts. Notifications can be turned off. Tapping one opens the cover. When the user hides the app with iOS 18 'Nascondi e richiedi Face ID', iOS suppresses its notifications: the app says so in the setup screen instead of promising alerts.
features.reason: Originale: 'my kid has my wife's phone ... notification pops up and she taps the notification' (opens the chat without the password). Between: 'notifications just disappear'.

features.name: Disappearing messages
features.description: Optional, off by default: messages delete themselves for both after 1 day or 7 days. The sender's device deletes its own expired records; the receiver hides them locally at expiry.
features.reason: Privacy without a fake icon. Originale reviews mention videos that vanished without warning: here it is a choice, shown in the thread header with a word.

features.name: Icons
features.description: Default icon: generic, in the Sbu grammar, an engraved gift box closed by the square full stop in accent-duo; says nothing about a conversation and matches the Regali cover. The home-screen name 'Sbu Duo' cannot change at runtime. Alternate icons per cover in a later version.
features.reason: Users hide the app anyway (iOS 18 Hidden apps); alternate icons only matter for those who keep it on the home screen.

features.name: End the conversation
features.description: Owner: delete the zone (removes everything for both). Participant: leave the share (removes it from their device). Both confirm with SbuButton(kind: .destructive).
features.reason: Between: 'Account info isn't available', data lost without control. Here the user decides and the result is clear.

screens.name: Cover
screens.purpose: The app's face, chosen by the user: Regali or Note, each a working tool on surface with its one figure (SbuToolField/SbuStat + SbuFullStop). Settings are never reachable from a cover.

screens.name: Conversation
screens.purpose: The tool screen on surface: thread of messages, own bubbles in the accent with onAccent text, the other's in surfaceRaised with ink. No figure here: the figure lives on Info.
elements: composer: text field, photo button, send (accent)
status per message: Inviato, Non inviato + Riprova
toolbar: the other person's name -> Info

screens.name: Gallery
screens.purpose: Grid of all photos, multi-select to save or delete.

screens.name: Pairing
screens.purpose: First run, before a partner joins.
elements: one line: 'Scrivi con una persona sola.'
iCloud missing: explanation + link to Settings

screens.purpose: Partner name, disappearing messages, notifications text, change code, Termina la conversazione (danger). No figure: the cover holds it.

screens.purpose: List .insetGrouped of covers with icon preview and the unlock gesture in one line each; selecting sets cover and icon together.

flows.name: First run

Icon changes (system alert from iOS), app now opens on the cover
Hide with iOS: one screen with the steps, 'Fatto' to close

Partner accepts: the conversation opens on both sides

data_model.Message (SwiftData + CKRecord): id, sender (CKRecord creator userRecordID), sentAt, text (encrypted), photo (CKAsset, optional), expiresAt (optional), state (local: pending, sent, failed)
data_model.Conversation (one per install): zoneID, share URL, isOwner, partnerName (from CKShare participant), sinceDate
data_model.Secret (Keychain): PBKDF2 salt, wrapped Curve25519 private key, pinned partner public key, throttle counter and interval; Secure Enclave key reference. No hash of the code.
data_model.Gifts cover (SwiftData, local only): person, idea, price (Decimal), occasion date, bought; never synced

monetization: Free. Promise block unchanged; the store page adds that messages go through each person's own iCloud.
pains: Lost photos and chats on the developer's server (Between, 14 of 27 reviews).
Messages that fail to send or arrive empty, decryption key errors, glitches (Just Between Us, 38 of 49).
Paywall on saving, deleting, videos and history over 30 days.
Notifications that open the chat without the password.
Ads, forced rating prompt, spam emails after signup.
Calculator#: ads every few seconds (50 of 183), media lost after reinstall or new phone (48), forgotten password with no recovery (17), a calculator that does not calculate.
pains_note: Keyword counts on unique 1-3 star reviews US+IT fetched 2026-10-15; one review can hit several pains.
skipped: Calls and video calls: FaceTime does it.
Video messages in 1.0: CKAsset size and upload reliability; P2 after 1.0.
Shared calendar, love letters, stickers, games: not the one thing.
More than one conversation: Messages does it.
Copying Apple's Calculator, Notes or Clock icons or names: impersonation.
Covers that need network (weather, news): not allowed in Sbu apps.
Changing the home-screen name per cover: iOS does not allow it.
Calculator cover: too well known as a vault disguise.
dependencies_note: Apple frameworks only. Capabilities: iCloud (CloudKit container), Push Notifications (for CloudKit subscriptions), Background Modes: remote-notification.

review_risks.risk: The reviewer has one device and one Apple ID: cannot pair.
review_risks.mitigation: Review notes with a video of two devices; a 'Prova da solo' mode where the app answers with sample messages written by us, local only.

review_risks.risk: Apple may ask for report and block in apps with user content.
review_risks.mitigation: Private one-to-one with a person the user invited; 'Termina la conversazione' is the block. State it in the review notes.

review_risks.risk: Chat apps are crowded; Sbu Chats exists in repo.
review_risks.mitigation: Chats analyses exported chats offline, Duo is a live conversation: no shared code or screens. Run originality-check before the submit.

review_risks.risk: Messages and photos of two people leave the device.
review_risks.mitigation: Only through each user's own iCloud (ADR-0011), Data Not Collected, privacy page explains CloudKit sharing and how to stop.

review_risks.risk: Covers looking like Apple's Calculator, Notes or Clock.
review_risks.mitigation: Sbu engraving icons, Sbu tokens, no Apple icon or Apple app name.

review_risks.risk: Viral as an affair app reflects on sbu.dev and the other apps on the account.
review_risks.mitigation: Listing and site speak of privacy at home and personal safety; never of partners to hide from. Decision for Matteo: same developer account or not.

review_risks.risk: An app that hides a chat behind a cover.
review_risks.mitigation: Documented: subtitle, description and screenshots show the covers and the unlock gestures, as Calculator# does (approved, 28,918 ratings). Review notes give a test code and a sample conversation.

review_risks.risk: Several mini tools could read as a bundle of templates.
review_risks.mitigation: Covers are the frame of one thing, the conversation; each is small, real and tested.

estimate_note: About 14 days: two covers with tests 2 (gifts 1.5, notes 0.5), code, Keychain and end-to-end encryption 3, CloudKit sharing and push 4, conversation and photos 3, cover switching, hide-with-iOS screen, safety code and polish 2. Two devices with two Apple IDs for testing.

source.reviews: research/1498275568/reviews.json (49 unique, 1-3 stars), research/458035189/reviews.json (27 unique), research/1165276801/reviews.json (183 unique)

threat_model.protects_against: A person who picks up the unlocked phone or knows its passcode: they must not learn that the conversation exists, read it, or recover it by resetting.
accepts: That person can delete the app or reset it, destroying the conversation (not reading it).
Lockout up to 60 minutes after 5 wrong inputs of 6-10 digits, which that person could also trigger.
out_of_scope: Jailbroken or forensically extracted devices beyond the local encryption.
The partner's own device and choices.
A 6-digit code is weak by itself; the Secure Enclave binding is what stops offline guessing. Without that device, the content cannot be opened at all.

decisions.name: Sbu Duo on the home screen and the store, slug duo; the store name says what is inside, e.g. 'Sbu Duo: chat privata nascosta'.
decisions.covers_1_0: Regali, Note, Nessuna. No calculator. No alternate icons in 1.0: the app is hidden with iOS.
decisions.notifications: On, random neutral text per cover, editable, can be turned off.
decisions.account: Same developer account; submit only after Apple answers the current lot, one submit per week.
decisions.accent: accent-duo, petrol, OKLCH hue 207 in the gap between Docs and Transcribe.
decisions.icon: Generic: engraved gift box, no chat symbols.
